svg.title: Build the Desk in Thirty Days Without Forcing a Trade
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-controlled-launch; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Build the Desk in Thirty Days Without Forcing a Trade; subtitle: Four weekly milestones establish evidence, liquidity and execution readiness.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The sprint builds operating capability, not an assumed first settlement. Canonical time to first deal remains one to three months. Paid tools and live purchases require funded commitments within the selected startup capital plan.; caption: Finish with a reconciled pilot or a documented reason to keep capital idle; neither projected rebates nor pending ACH fund repayment.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Establish counterparties, rules and capital boundaries; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Vet at least two buying groups, record Net-3 or Net-5 terms, map ticket jurisdictions and confirm issuer resale eligibility. Select the startup budget and concentration limits.; label: Days 8-14; value: Build linked order, inventory and statement ledgers; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Implement the deal-commit reconciler and 60-day obligation view. Test partial ACH, duplicate payouts, rebate reversals and transfer failures; evaluate SkyBox or Automatiq inventory synchronization.; label: Days 15-21; value: Rehearse full settlement before a bounded pilot; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run a documented purchase-to-settlement simulation. Execute one small purchase only when commitments, transfer rights, insurance and repayment cash are verified; otherwise continue sourcing.; label: Days 22-30; value: Reconcile evidence and set the next exposure limit; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Match cleared receipts and due card obligations where a pilot exists. Review aging, realized spread and markdown behavior; expand only within funded limits and documented capacity.

text.title: Build the Desk in Thirty Days Without Forcing a Trade

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Establish counterparties, rules and capital boundaries; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Vet at least two buying groups, record Net-3 or Net-5 terms, map ticket jurisdictions and confirm issuer resale eligibility. Select the startup budget and concentration limits.

text.title: Establish counterparties, rules and capital boundaries

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Build linked order, inventory and statement ledgers; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Implement the deal-commit reconciler and 60-day obligation view. Test partial ACH, duplicate payouts, rebate reversals and transfer failures; evaluate SkyBox or Automatiq inventory synchronization.

text.title: Build linked order, inventory and statement ledgers

rect.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Rehearse full settlement before a bounded pilot; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run a documented purchase-to-settlement simulation. Execute one small purchase only when commitments, transfer rights, insurance and repayment cash are verified; otherwise continue sourcing.

text.title: Rehearse full settlement before a bounded pilot

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Reconcile evidence and set the next exposure limit; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Match cleared receipts and due card obligations where a pilot exists. Review aging, realized spread and markdown behavior; expand only within funded limits and documented capacity.
